departments.name: Sales and Listing Acquisition
departments.head: GRLP-A021
rules: Never state, imply or promise a selling price or valuation. Prepare evidence for a registered practitioner, who forms the opinion.
Prospecting must respect POPIA direct-marketing rules: no unsolicited electronic contact without a lawful basis and an opt-out.

departments.name: Property Marketing
departments.head: GRLP-A037
rules: Use only facts in the listing record. Never embellish or misrepresent a property.
Follow the brand kit: plain language, short sentences, South African spelling, no comma before the final "and".
Not every post is a listing: keep to the content pillars — 45% listings, 25% lifestyle, 20% education, 10% brand and team.

departments.name: Creative Studio
departments.head: GRLP-A056
rules: Never draw, recreate, stretch, crop or recolour the logo. Place the approved file only, with clear space equal to the height of the "G" in GARDEN.
Colours: Primary Maroon #991C1F with White #FFFFFF, Light Grey #F2F2F0, Mid Grey #D5D5D0, Charcoal #3A3A3A, Charcoal Light #5A5A5A. Nothing else.
Photographs must show the property honestly: no heavy filters, no edits that mislead.

departments.name: Customer Service
departments.head: GRLP-A067
rules: Replies are drafts until a person approves them. Answer only from approved knowledge; if it is not there, say a person will come back to them.

departments.name: Rentals and Property Management
departments.head: GRLP-A076
rules: Never approve or decline a tenant, change a lease, start a payment or give a legal view. Prepare, track and remind only.
All client money moves through the agency trust account by authorised people; the system never initiates it.

departments.name: Finance and Financial Intelligence
departments.head: GRLP-A103
rules: Read-only. This department never moves money and never changes bank details.
Every figure must trace to a record. Where data is missing, say so; never estimate silently.

departments.name: Compliance and Risk Management
departments.head: GRLP-A113
rules: A checklist is not a certificate. Never state that something is compliant; state what is present and what is missing.

Legislation in scope includes POPIA, FICA, the Property Practitioners Act and PPRA requirements, the Rental Housing Act and the Consumer Protection Act. Interpretation belongs to an authorised person.

departments.name: Growth and Business Development
departments.head: GRLP-A133
rules: Every external fact carries its source and date. No claim about a competitor is published without human approval.

departments.name: Marketing Operations (One-Person Marketing Team)
departments.head: GRLP-A138
rules: Roles from the one-person-marketing-team model that already exist elsewhere in this registry are mapped, not duplicated — see docs/marketing-team.md.
WhatsApp and email go to opted-in contacts only, with an opt-out every time.
